# Quarkus AG-UI (`quarkus-agui`)

> Orthogonal Java 17 Quarkus, LangChain4j & A2A (`1.5.0.Final`) adapters built on the official upstream AG-UI SDK (`com.ag-ui.community:0.1.1`), paired with a headless Svelte 5 Runes SDK (`@agui/svelte`) and a Java 25 + Quarkus `3.40.1.1` Tri-Protocol (`AG-UI + MCP + A2A`) reference showcase (`v0.2.0`).

## Core Documentation & Developer Guides
- [README.md](./README.md): 10–30–90 Developer Landing Page, Maven/pnpm Install & Minimal Working Example
- [wiki/Home.md](./wiki/Home.md): Project Wiki Home, Tutorials, Tri-Protocol Walkthrough & Sitemap
- [wiki/Architecture.md](./wiki/Architecture.md): Clean Architecture Concentric Rings, Tri-Protocol Design & Coupling Telemetry
- [wiki/Skills-Reference.md](./wiki/Skills-Reference.md): Public Java 17 / `@agui/svelte` API Reference & Agentic SDLC CLI/Skills Reference
- [wiki/Traceability.md](./wiki/Traceability.md): Requirements, ADR Lineage, Kanban Operations & Cryptographic Audit Chain
- [wiki/Codebase-Map.md](./wiki/Codebase-Map.md): Deterministic AST Export Signatures, Archlens Rings, Capabilities & ADRs
- [examples/quarkus-svelte-skeleton/README.md](./examples/quarkus-svelte-skeleton/README.md): Nomad Cultural & Architectural Concierge Tri-Protocol Showcase Guide (`:8080`, `:8081`, `:8082`)
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md): Local Reactor Build, JaCoCo/PITest Dual-Gate TDD, GraalVM 25 Native & PR Workflow
- [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md): Keep-a-Changelog Release History (`v0.1.0` – `v0.2.0` & Unreleased)

## Module & Package Entrypoints (Quick Context for Coding Agents)
- `ag-ui-bom` (`org.agui:ag-ui-bom:0.2.0`): Maven BOM managing `org.agui:*:0.2.0`, `com.ag-ui.community:{java-core,java-server,java-client}:0.1.1`, and `org.a2aproject.sdk:a2a-java-sdk-bom:1.5.0.Final`.
- `ag-ui-quarkus` (`org.agui:ag-ui-quarkus:0.2.0`, Java 17): `AgUiQuarkusBridge`, `AgUiWebSocketHandler`, `AgUiJacksonSerializer`, `AgUiObjectMapperCustomizer`, `AgUiSessionRegistry`, and 57-type GraalVM `reflect-config.json`.
- `ag-ui-langchain4j` (`org.agui:ag-ui-langchain4j:0.2.0`, Java 17): `AgUiLangChain4jBridge`, `AgUiLangChain4jRunSession`, `AgUiRunOptions` (`postToolActivityProvider`, `postRunActivityProvider`, `interruptSupplier`), `AgUiStatePatch` (RFC 6902), and `AgUiMcpBridge`.
- `ag-ui-quarkus-langchain4j` (`org.agui:ag-ui-quarkus-langchain4j:0.2.0`, Java 17): `AgUiQuarkusLangChain4jBridge` adapting Quarkiverse `Multi<ChatEvent>` into `Multi<Event>`, SSE, and WebSocket JSON payloads.
- `ag-ui-a2a` (`org.agui:ag-ui-a2a:0.2.0`, Java 17): `AgUiA2aClient`, `AgUiA2aBridge`, `A2aDelegationResult`, and `A2aHandoff` over `org.a2aproject.sdk` `1.5.0.Final`.
- `packages/agui-svelte` (`@agui/svelte@0.2.0`): `HttpAgent`, `WebSocketAgent`, `createAgUiStore`, `useAgUiAgent`, `applyJsonPatch`, `AGUI_ACTIVITY_TYPES`, `createActivityRegistry`, `buildPlaceMapLinks`, and `PROTOCOL_CALL_TAXONOMY`.
